clusters.headline: South Korea Imposes Stricter Penalties Following AI Exam Scandal
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Han Seong-sook ordered a comprehensive investigation into reports of cheating on state-administered examinations.
Proposed measures include distributing 8,000 metal detectors and implementing 10-year bans for students caught using AI-assisted technology.

clusters.headline: (LEAD) S. Korea's Lee calls for stronger joint crisis response by ASEAN, Korea, China, Japan
aiSummaryBullets: Yonhap reports: (LEAD) S. Korea's Lee calls for stronger joint crisis response by ASEAN, Korea, China, Japan
The Japan Times reports: South Korea’s Lee hopes reopening talks with North Korea could lead to lasting peace

clusters.headline: South Korean Democratic Party Seeks Impeachment Of Chief Justice
aiSummaryBullets: The Democratic Party aims to initiate an impeachment motion against the Supreme Court chief justice on December 3.
The planned action follows the Supreme Court's decision to order a retrial for former Prime Minister Han regarding his martial law role.

clusters.headline: Seoul Shares Rebound Over 6 Percent Following Jensen Huang Return
aiSummaryBullets: The Korea Composite Stock Price Index gained 6.32 percent, closing at 5,006.03 points on Tuesday.
The market recovery follows a period of volatility and a previous two-day rout linked to concerns over artificial intelligence developments.

Yonhap reports: No. of ministries, gov't agencies set to relocate to Sejong reduced to 31

clusters.headline: Seoul Metro Labor Talks Deadlocked Ahead Of Planned General Strike
aiSummaryBullets: Seoul Metro labor unions and management failed to reach an agreement during final negotiations on Tuesday.
The labor unions are threatening an indefinite general strike beginning Wednesday if demands are not met.

clusters.headline: Seoul issues emergency alert for Ulleung Island after suspected Russian aircraft violates airspace
aiSummaryBullets: Yonhap reports: Seoul issues emergency alert for Ulleung Island after suspected Russian aircraft violates airspace
NDTV reports: South Korea Says Suspected North Korean Aircraft Breached Island's Airspace

clusters.headline: Nvidia Maintains GPU Supply Commitments To South Korea Post-Huang
aiSummaryBullets: Nvidia has maintained its commitment to supply South Korea with graphics processing units.
The assurance follows the resignation of Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang.

clusters.headline: Justice Minister Nominee Lee Yong-cheol Discusses Criminal Charges
aiSummaryBullets: Justice Minister nominee Lee Yong-cheol faced questioning regarding the potential dismissal of criminal charges against President Lee Jae Myung.
The nominee stated he would not exercise his ministerial powers in a way the public considers unacceptable but did not rule out interventions.

clusters.headline: Middle School Student Identified In Shinsegae Fake Bomb Threat Case
aiSummaryBullets: A middle school student is the suspect in a false bomb threat sent to South Korean authorities.
The threatening message claimed an explosive device was hidden at a Shinsegae department store branch.

clusters.headline: Actors Lim Ji-yeon And Lee Do-hyun Separate After Four Year Relationship
aiSummaryBullets: South Korean actors Lim Ji-yeon and Lee Do-hyun have ended their four-year romantic relationship.
The split follows years of media attention regarding the couple's professional and personal lives.

Yonhap reports: (LEAD) N. Korea threatens to close Swiss office in Pyongyang over sanctions on children's camp

clusters.headline: South Korea Wins Men's Relay Gold At Short Track World Tour Event
aiSummaryBullets: South Korean skaters claimed the gold medal in the men's 5,000-meter relay at the International Skating Union Short Track World Tour.
The winning team, comprised of Shin Dong-min, Kim Tae-sung, Lee Jeong-min, and Rim Jong-un, outperformed skaters from the Netherlands and Canada.

Yonhap reports: Kim A-lim falters late, ties for 7th at LPGA season finale

clusters.headline: Samsung And SK Hynix Shares Plummet Amid Global Tech Market Slump
aiSummaryBullets: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix shares recorded significant losses during Friday trading on the Korea Exchange.
The decline follows a broader Wall Street technology sell-off and investor apprehension regarding the sustainability of the AI market.

clusters.headline: Singer Mark From NCT Announces Upcoming Solo Studio Album Windmill
aiSummaryBullets: The former NCT member Mark will release his new studio album titled Windmill next month.
The upcoming album includes the lead single What’s Your Dream? Don’t Have One and previously released B-sides.

aiSummaryBullets: Yonhap reports: (URGENT) KRX activates buy-side sidecar for KOSPI on sharp rise
The Korea Herald reports: Seoul shares surge on Jensen Huang's return, triggering buy-side sidecar

clusters.headline: South Korea Exports Double In November On Record Chip Shipments
aiSummaryBullets: South Korea's total export value reached 77.4 billion dollars between November 1 and 20.
The data from the Korea Customs Service shows a substantial increase from the 38.4 billion dollars recorded during the same period last year.

clusters.headline: President Lee Jae Myung Sees Approval Rating Increase To 37 Percent
aiSummaryBullets: President Lee Jae Myung recorded a 37.3 percent approval rating in a poll conducted by Realmeter.
The president's job performance rating increased by 0.9 percentage points over the past week.

clusters.headline: President Lee Jae Myung Appoints First Female National Intelligence Chief
aiSummaryBullets: President Lee Jae Myung has nominated Kang Kum-sil to serve as the new head of the National Intelligence Service.
If confirmed, the 69-year-old former justice minister would become the first woman to lead the South Korean spy agency since its founding in 1961.
